meeting: Post Quantum Transaction Signature (PQTS) Breakout #16 - September 30, 2025

testnet_status.highlight: Testnet v0.1 (ERC-4337 + Lean SPHINCS variant) and v0.2 (ERC-4337 + native frame tx via EIP-8141) already deployed; v0.3 targeting mempool aggregation
EIP-8288 (signature aggregation) is next target; LeanVM fork by Emil parameterized to match current devnet; 20 signatures/sec wrapping speed on regular hardware (preliminary)
Nethermind (and ethrex) to ship embedded LeanVM for native block verification — no precompile or Solidity contract; replaces ECDSA verification path

eip_8288_aggregation_design.highlight: Block structure for v0.3: transactions stripped of individual signatures + single constant-size aggregated proof SA produced by LeanVM; size independent of tx count
Targeting EIP-8288 test case 7 (aggregator = block builder, wraps test case 1 with recursive STARK); wrapper object carries dependency reference + actual Lean SPHINCS signature, decoupled from frame
Open problem: how receiving Nethermind/ethrex nodes verify the aggregated LeanVM proof natively without precompile; consensus is native integration required, not yet implemented

ethrex_prototype.highlight: lambdaclass ethrex branch eip-8288 has working in-mempool aggregation prototype with LeanVM; benchmarks committed; covers validation and mempool aggregation

action_items.action: Stefano De Angelis (Nethermind) to bring concrete test-case-7 solution proposal to next call
Antonio to invite Vitalik / Tomas (EIP-8288 authors) to a future call for design clarification

decisions.decision: v0.3 testnet will implement aggregation once per block (not every slot) as simplest first end-to-end milestone

targets.target: Testnet v0.3 — first end-to-end EIP-8288 aggregation with Nethermind or ethrex (timeline TBD, targeting next ~2 weeks)
